name: David (Zhiyuan) Yang
headline: Software Dev Engineer @ AWS | AI & Computer Vision Researcher
title: Engineer, Researcher, Entrepreneur
bio: David (Zhiyuan) Yang is a Software Development Engineer at AWS and Computer Vision Researcher. With a passion for scalable distributed architecture and artificial intelligence, his expertise spans machine learning, computer vision, high-throughput cloud systems, and generative AI. Previously, he co-founded BugTech AR, delivering immersive augmented reality products, and holds dual Master's degrees in Computer Science (4.0 GPA, Northeastern University) and Landscape Architecture (RISD).

experience.description: Designed and maintained scalable, fault-tolerant AWS infrastructure to manage high-volume log delivery for internal services and external clients. Architected robust retry/redrive mechanisms to recover failed log transmissions, ensuring SLA-compliant delivery.

Enhanced platform functionality and user experience through feature development, including code block insertion function, multi-format file preview system, and shared URL generation system. Contributed to the beta launch of the next-generation product by implementing GenAI-driven features.
Built and maintained an AI-powered audio denoise web app using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind for front end; Node.js, AWS S3, AWS SageMaker, and PostgreSQL for back end.

Proposed an innovative end-to-end forest fire risk assessment system combining YOLOv8 object detection, UAV imagery, and geospatial visualization techniques. Published peer-reviewed research in MDPI Drones (2024).

Designed and implemented an Augmented Reality game to achieve an interactive spatial AR experience, blending virtual spaces over physical reality. Won several entrepreneurial competition awards in 2021.
Developed and maintained an in-house digital asset management system with React, Flask, and MongoDB, improving efficiency and streamlining digital asset organization.
